scene: You zoom onto the vibrant glass track as floating holosigns flicker alive.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a luminous glass racetrack suspended high over Pixel City. On the left lies a glowing neon arrow speed pad. The player in her purple wheelchair rolls swiftly near centre. Right of centre hovers a humming holographic course map. On the far right curves an open striped corkscrew launch ramp.
shown: a pulsing neon arrow pad glowing brightly on the track at the left
a floating pixelated route projector hovering right of centre
a steep striped loop ramp leading upward at the far right

variants.scene: Your wheels sparkle across glowing blue glass beneath the towering evening city skyline.
Cool twilight air rushes past while you hum {tune} beside the humming track.
Neon arrows pulse behind you as a massive curved coaster track looms ahead.
